title: ЗАЛУЧЕНІСТЬ СТУДЕНТІВ-СПОРТСМЕНІВ РІЗНИХ СПЕЦІАЛІЗАЦІЙ В УМОВАХ ГЕЙМІФІКОВАНОГО ДИСТАНЦІЙНОГО НАВЧАННЯ ВИДАМ ЛЕГКОЇ АТЛЕТИКИ В ЗВО
reason: Ukrainian-language gamification experiment (EG vs CG). Moodle/Kahoot/Slack log indices are only compared between groups and described; no analysis relates any per-student log indicator to EGameFlow engagement, workload or learning success.

extraction.design: quasi-experimental two-group (EG vs CG), Mann-Whitney/t-test, pre/post
extraction.population: student athletes training as coaches, physical-education programme, 1 university
extraction.lms_indicators: Moodle regularity index, completion rate, gamification engagement index; Kahoot participation and attendance stability; Slack message indices
extraction.notes: EG 26 + CG 26. Analyses are group contrasts and within-group pre/post (effect size r = z/sqrt(n) for those tests); no indicator-outcome correlation. Language: Ukrainian (eligible under E6).
